name: 丰川祥子 · 雨夜欲言

description.zh: 浅蓝长发、金眼、细辫和黑蝴蝶结。
description.en: Long powder-blue hair, golden eyes, thin side braids and black ribbon bows.

positive.zh: {{A}}浅蓝长发垂在肩侧，两条细辫系着小黑蝴蝶结。她抬起金色的眼睛，下眼睑留着一层淡淡的疲色。
positive.en: {{A}} has long powder-blue hair, fine side braids tied with small black bows, and amber eyes. Faint shadows sit under her lower lids as she looks up.

positive.zh: 她在磨旧的木地板上跪坐，双膝并拢，背脊仍挺直。眉心微微收紧。她吸了口气，嘴唇才刚张开，就这样停住了。
positive.en: She kneels on the worn floorboards, knees together, back still straight. Her brows draw together slightly. She draws breath to speak; her lips part, then she hesitates.

positive.zh: 她在下巴正下方摊开空手，两只掌心朝上、略向镜头倾斜。靠近镜头的一只手稍低，指尖微微回弯。抬手带起袖口，露出一排颜色稍深的补线。
positive.en: She holds her empty hands just below her chin, both palms open to the lens. The nearer hand sits a little lower, its fingertips curling back. Her raised wrist reveals a line of darker mending stitches across one cuff.

positive.zh: 米白衬衫已经洗软，细黑领结依然系得平整。灰格裙在并拢的膝盖上铺得整整齐齐。
positive.en: Her ivory blouse is worn soft from washing. The narrow black ribbon at her throat is tied neatly. Her grey plaid skirt lies smooth across her knees.

positive.zh: 她身后靠墙放着折起的薄被，一个倒扣的纸箱充作小桌。上面搁着一盒还没拆封的便当，盒盖上贴着折扣签。
positive.en: Behind her, a thin folded futon rests against the wall. An upturned cardboard box serves as a table for one unopened bento with a discount sticker.

positive.zh: 镜头贴近、正面略俯视。雨水挂在身后的窗玻璃上，窗光冷蓝；从门缝漏进来的一线暖光只擦亮了她的脸颊和补过的袖口。
positive.en: Close frontal view from slightly above her eyes. Cold blue light filters through the rain-streaked window. A sliver of warm hallway light catches her cheek and the mended cuff.

notes: 根据雨夜版画面重新编写。正面略俯视，双掌抬至下巴，保留祥子的日常衣着与礼貌坐姿。
